subject: shiny + ggvis,  layer_histograms/layer_rect bug with set_options(duration = 0)

messages.author: 64ad306a7a60d950
messages.subject: shiny + ggvis,  layer_histograms/layer_rect bug with set_options(duration = 0)
parts:
I have a shiny app with a checkbox.  When the checkbox is unselected it will display only one population (pop1), when the checkbox is selected it will show both populations (pop1 and pop2) and fill them with a different color.  The problem is with set_options(duration = 0): if this option is not included by triggering the checkbox a few times the histograms will quite often fail to render properly.  If this option is included then the histograms will display properly but without the snazzy transitions.

Example code:

#server.R
library(shiny)
library(ggvis)

set.seed(1)
pop1 = data.frame(x = rnorm(1000, 0, 1), g = rep(1, 1000))
pop2 = data.frame(x = rnorm(1000, 5, 1), g = rep(2, 1000))
data = rbind(pop1, pop2)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  choose_data = reactive({
    if(input$show) return(data %>% group_by(g))
    else return(subset(data, g == 1) %>% group_by(g))
  })
  
  choose_data %>% ggvis(x = ~x) %>% layer_histograms(fill = ~g) %>%
    #set_options(duration = 0) %>%  #if this is commented out strange things happen
    bind_shiny("ggvis")
})

#ui.R
library(shiny)
library(ggvis)

shinyUI( fluidPage(
  fluidRow(
    column(
        width = 2,
        checkboxInput("show", "show")
      ),
    
    column(
      width = 5,
      ggvisOutput("ggvis")
    )
  )
))
